item.description: Former Italian police chief Gianni De Gennaro, under ⁠investigation for alleged efforts to obstruct a new probe into the 1992 killing of a top anti-mafia magistrate, has taken his own life, an official familiar with the matter said on Saturday. Air Niugini’s flight PX19 to Port Moresby, the capital of Papua New Guinea, made the unscheduled stop at Davao International Airport at about 12.08am, according to Philippine media, citing the Civil Aviation Authority of the Philippines (CAAP). item.description: A slow-paced Chinese reality show about fractured friendships has proved an unexpected cultural phenomenon, sparking a nationwide reckoning over huorengan – the messy, unscripted sense of being alive – as AI companions and algorithm-driven microdramas flourish. item.description: With a history as long as China’s, some cultural traditions are bound to fade into antiquity. This is especially true of food, which can change dramatically within a single lifetime. Some changes are fundamental, making it almost impossible to imagine the culture without them; others are quirks of history. item.description: If one manifestation of the economic difficulties Japan faced from the 1990s was falling inflation and bond yields, then China is falling into the same malaise. Starting with longer maturities, interest rates on government debt in China have been falling below equivalents in Japan. The People’s Bank of China’s recent announcement of an overnight policy rate of 1.25 per cent brings the process close to completion.
